title: Perp vs spot
description: The Bybit perpetual's mark price against the blended spot reference. It says whether leverage is leading or lagging the spot market.

state.label: Basis state
state.description: Rich when the perp is above spot, cheap when below, flat inside a small band. Rich means leveraged buyers are ahead of spot.

basis_bps.label: Basis
basis_bps.description: Perp mark minus blended spot as a share of price, in basis points. Positive means the perp is rich to spot.

basis_change_bps_60s.label: Basis change 60s
basis_change_bps_60s.description: How much the basis moved over the last minute, in basis points. A fast change means leverage is repricing.
